text.text: The NetApp FAS3220 and FAS3250 storage systems are NetApp’s most powerful midrange platforms ever. They offer unprecedented support for flash and enterprise clustering, enabling you to build an agile data infrastructure that adapts to support any combination of application workloads—without introducing complexity. The FAS3200 Series: Combines reliable, high-performance hardware with the NetApp Data ONTAP®, the world’s #1 storage OS Turbocharges key applications with up to 2TB of high-speed flash Supports clustered Data ONTAP, enabling seamless scaling from 2 to 24 nodes Reduces storage needs starting on day one through NetApp’s industry-leading storage efficiency Uses 50% less storage in virtual environments, guaranteed Nondisruptive operations eliminates planned downtime and operational overhead
